label: copy-phase input 3 late in the sequence, strongest when the next output is 0
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (90% of activations, 95% of mass) when the fed-back input is the digit 3, and only from recall_idx 3 onward (t >= 8, mostly long sequences, L 7-9). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Magnitude depends on what is being output: the strongest activations (top quartile, about 80% covered) are steps where the input is 3 and the current output is 0, i.e. the original had the bigram 3 0. Plain input 3 in the copy phase has high recall but only about 5% precision, so most copy-phase 3s stay silent. The narrow predicate (input 3, output 0, recall_idx >= 3) reaches about 0.67 precision but covers only 41% of activations and 63% of mass. The remaining weak activations are on input 3 followed by other tokens (h, b, other digits), plus a small amount on input 0 (about 5% of mass). Firing rate goes up with t and L. It does not fire on letters (except a little on h) or on the first occurrence of a token.
